description.blurb: S/2004 S 36 is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 36 is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1319.07 days, at an inclination of 155° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.748, the highest of any of Saturn's moons.
